title: Groz 1" Drive Impact socket | Chrome Molybdenum Construction | Easy Tool Engagement | Black Oxide Finish | ISKT/H/0-1/30
description: GROZ impact sockets are crafted from high-quality Chrome Molybdenum steel, offering exceptional strength, hardness, and torque resistance. The specially designed chamfered openings ensure smooth engagement with impact tools, saving time and effort. A pin hole allows compatibility with tools featuring a pin and ring retaining mechanism for a secure fit. The black oxide finish provides superior corrosion resistance while making it easy to distinguish from regular sockets. Each socket is laser-etched with size and branding for quick and convenient identification during use.
